title: owlery-vfb: Owlery reasoner endpoint configured for the Virtual Fly Brain ontology
description:
Container build and configuration for the Owlery OWL reasoner endpoint used by Virtual Fly Brain. It serves DL queries over VFB's ontology, and is what answers the classification and subsumption queries behind VFB's search and its neuron/region browsing.

By default it loads owlery-live.owl as published at http://VirtualFlyBrain.org/data/VFB/OWL/owlery-live.owl; the OWLURL environment variable overrides this, and LOGLEVEL controls logging. Request and idle timeouts are set to 240 seconds to survive long prefix-resolution queries.

This repository contains VFB's Dockerfile and configuration only. Owlery itself is separate software by the Phenoscape project, MIT licensed, at https://github.com/phenoscape/owlery . This repository began as a fork of https://github.com/Robbie1977/docker-sbt-owlery .
